Modernize it through YOUNG Chinese Guochao fashion for ages 16-35: bright breathable palette, brocade accents, embroidered gauze, small cloud-collar structure, pankou knot buttons, short cropped Chinese jacket, pearl embroidery, jade-white and lake-blue accents, cinnabar red details, soft gold ornaments, light sporty styling. Keep it Chinese, fresh, festive, refined, commercial, and wearable. No gothic, no cyberpunk, no black leather dominance, no techwear, no tactical harness, no samurai, no kimono, no Japanese elements, no dark fantasy armor, no cheap cosplay, no text, no watermark.

Create a bright youthful Guochao storefront/studio master visual. Preserve the xiqu headwear and experience? layout from the reference, but make the space a premium young fashion boutique: red-brick wall, warm wood, brass display shelves, ivory fabric curtains, mirror bulbs, clean styling chairs, display stands with phoenix crown and marshal helmet. Foreground model wears blue-white-pink opera headwear, black forehead hair patches, pearl tassels, and a jade-white cropped jacket with lake-blue embroidery, small cloud collar, pankou buttons, soft pink sash, detachable translucent sleeves, ivory wide-leg trousers. Background models show red martial and pink floral youth packages. Bright, elegant, young Chinese national trend, not gothic, not stereotypical new-Chinese.
